tables.caption: Timeline of Amaravati
rows: AP Reorganization Act comes into force
Location of new capital city finalized
Consent for 33,000 acres obtained from farmers
Amaravati city bhoomi puja (ground-breaking ceremony) by Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu [ 22 ]
Foundation stone set by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi [ 23 ]
Government Legislature and secretariat start functioning from the city
Chandrababu Naidu lays foundation stone for Andhra Pradesh Permanent secretariat towers [ 24 ] [ 25 ]
CJI lays foundation stone for Andhra High Court in Amaravati. [ 26 ]
Governor's assent to legislation for three capitals
High court gives verdict in favour of single capital city
All development works have been restarted and work is in progress. [ 27 ] [ 28 ]
Amaravati named the sole, official capital of Andhra Pradesh through the Andhra Pradesh Reorganization Bill, 2026.
Potential completion of infrastructure in Phase I. [ 29 ]
